title: concept-db is intermittently saturated while reporting healthy by every liveness signal: ActiveState=active, SubState=ru
description: concept-db is intermittently saturated while reporting healthy by every liveness signal: ActiveState=active, SubState=running, NRestarts=0, yet GET /health does not answer within 10.9s. It sits on the goal walks critical path — goal-host walk-concepts recall timed out 37 times in 6 hours against a 12000ms budget with 3 attempts, so a stalled walk burns 36s and then proceeds WITHOUT its concepts, which is information starvation at the point of use. Positive control: recall succeeded 50 times in 24h returning rows=1..5, so the vessel is degraded rather than dead. concept-db logs show searchConcepts BM25 scores all zero with a term-frequency proxy fallback and the dense leg returning nothing within its 2000ms budget, at ~172 searchConcepts calls per 10 minutes.
